mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_report (session_id, round_no, title, content, status, create_by) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{roundNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM analysis_report WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND round_no = #{roundNo}
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, round_no, title, content, status, create_by, create_time, update_time FROM analysis_report WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY round_no DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
